verdict.rationale: OpenCode publishes a machine-readable API surface: `opencode serve` exposes an OpenAPI endpoint, a probe confirms a live openapi.json, and a type-safe JS/TS SDK is documented. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, explorable API reference page or runnable in-browser examples. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer (e.g. a try-it console), runnable code examples in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of the API docs experience.
